prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1190; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: Sure. I'm [Claimant Name], and I was driving the sedan involved in the accident.

Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection?

A: I was heading east and wanted to turn left onto the side street. I had a green light, but I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic to clear before I went.

Q: Did you have a turn signal on?

A: Yes, I'd had my left signal on for a good while before I started to move.

Q: How did the other vehicle approach?

A: It came from the opposite direction, and when I started the turn it hit the front driver's side of my car. I didn't see it coming until the last second.

Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?

A: No, I didn't hit my head. My body jerked forward and back pretty hard, though.

Q: Have you noticed any injuries since the accident?

A: My neck is sore and stiff, mostly on the right side. I've had some headaches too, and turning my head to check mirrors hurts.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or gone to an urgent care facility?

A: I went to urgent care the same day. They said it looked like a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and use ice.

Q: Are you currently receiving any other treatment?

A: I have a follow-up scheduled with my primary care doctor next week, and I'm doing some gentle stretching at home.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and I feel the other driver should have been watching for me. That's about it.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
